title: Pomegranate: modeled ₹1,105/qtl left, Kathua → Palampur
summary: January 2022: reported pomegranate prices at Kathua and Palampur imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 91% of 22 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,105 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 62 same-variety market pairs screened for pomegranate in January 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Palampur report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2022
scenes.caption: Kathua (Jammu and Kashmir) and Palampur (Himachal Pradesh) both reported pomegranate prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 22 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kathua reported a median ₹6,750 per quintal. Palampur reported a median ₹8,375 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,750/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,750 per quintal, and Palampur was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 140 km by road
scenes.caption: 140 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹30/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹864 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹384 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Palampur report, the rule selects 18 of 22 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,105 per quintal (₹669 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pomegranate route from Kathua to Palampur was positive on 91% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹110,500, or ₹66,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to pomegranate
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹30/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pomegranate route from Kathua to Palampur was positive on 91% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹110,500, or ₹66,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Pomegranate: modeled ₹2,002/qtl left, Dhanotu (Mandi) → Kangra (Baijnath)
summary: October 2022: reported pomegranate prices at Dhanotu (Mandi) and Kangra (Baijnath) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 79% of 19 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹2,002 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 122 same-variety market pairs screened for pomegranate in October 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kangra (Baijnath) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.

Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.
